books.title: Ambiguity Everywhere
books.subtitle: Shaping our lives, society, and the world
books.coverAlt: Cover of Ambiguity Everywhere by Jared Cosulich: a salmon jigsaw puzzle with missing and loose pieces
books.blurb: All of life’s experiences, from how we learn, to our relationships, to scientific progress, to the economy, to voting, and much more, are ambiguous. Ambiguity Everywhere explores these wide-ranging aspects of our world and how experts in each approach and manage ambiguity.

quotes.text: Doubt is not a pleasant condition, but certainty is an absurd one.
